_: Each release's module build per kernel, as measured on a host running it: /sys/module/mxfs/version and /sys/module/mxfs/srcversion read together. A host that builds the module against its own kernel (DKMS, or make on Proxmox) has its own srcversion for the same source, so a run on such a host is tied to a release by this table (tools/release_status.py). Add a line only from a host that reported both values.
